title: Secret Manager: versions, rotation and access by service account

videos.script: The shop needs a database password. It must not live in the code, the image, or the repository. {{where}} Secret Manager keeps it as a secret with numbered versions. One service account may read it, and nobody else. {{versions}} The program reads it when it starts, from a file the platform mounts. And it never prints it. {{read}} Here is the trap. Anything Terraform manages ends up in its state, in plain text. Sensitive hides it from the screen, not from the file. You will see the password sitting there. {{state}} Rotation is a reminder, not an action. Something you run changes the password, in an order that breaks nothing. {{rotation}}
